title: AI & Data Systems
tagline: Pipelines, classifiers and LLM-powered tools, directed and tested by me

projects.name: INDRA
projects.description: National Disaster Risk Analysis Platform (Smart India Hackathon team project). Cleans 5,000 raw posts to ~4,250 across English, Hindi and Hinglish, classifies 23 hazard types at 97% accuracy (99% with rules), and verifies against IMD bulletins.

projects.name: Jester
projects.description: Real-time fraud detection pipeline that streams simulated card purchases and flags impossible-travel, rapid-velocity and amount-spike fraud on a live map. State lives in Redis, with 115 automated tests.

projects.name: NIMBUS AEGIS ReliefMatch
projects.description: Flags surpluses and shortages and reroutes stock between warehouses. An LLM parses free-text donation offers, and the tools are exposed on an MCP server.

projects.name: Staff Email Automation
projects.description: Prototype that detects birthdays, anniversaries and service milestones and drafts personalized emails from verified data, with approval, scheduling and an audit log. 25 automated tests.
